mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT notification_id FROM community_push_deliveries WHERE 1=0 UNION ALL SELECT notification_id FROM user_notifications WHERE 1=0 UNION ALL SELECT subscription_id FROM user_push_subscriptions WHERE community_started_at IS NOT NULL AND 1=0 )
mapper.sql: n.user_id=p.user_id AND n.read_at IS NULL AND (n.actor_id IS NULL OR n.actor_id<>n.user_id) AND n.notification_type IN ('POST_COMMENT','COMMENT_REPLY','POST_HELPFUL','COMMENT_HELPFUL','ADMIN_REPORT','INFO_REVIEW','REPORT_RESULT') AND (n.notification_type<>'ADMIN_REPORT' OR UPPER(TRIM(CAST(u.is_admin AS VARCHAR2(10)))) IN ('1','Y','YES','TRUE','ADMIN')) AND n.created_at >= CAST(#{cutoff,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AS DATE) AND n.created_at <= CAST(#{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AS DATE) AND n.created_at >= CAST(p.community_started_at AS DATE) AND (u.push_enabled IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(CAST(u.push_enabled AS VARCHAR2(10)))) IN ('1','Y','TRUE'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_push_deliveries(notification_id,subscription_id,status,attempts,next_attempt_at,created_at) SELECT notification_id,subscription_id,'PENDING',0,#{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},#{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} FROM ( SELECT n.notification_id,p.subscription_id FROM user_notifications n JOIN user_push_subscriptions p ON p.user_id=n.user_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id=n.user_id WHERE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM community_push_deliveries d WHERE d.notification_id=n.notification_id AND d.subscription_id=p.subscription_id) ORDER BY n.notification_id,p.subscription_id FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY )
mapper.select: SELECT d.notification_id,p.subscription_id,p.user_id,n.post_id,n.notification_type, p.endpoint,p.endpoint_hash,p.public_key,p.auth_secret FROM community_push_deliveries d JOIN user_notifications n ON n.notification_id=d.notification_id JOIN user_push_subscriptions p ON p.subscription_id=d.subscription_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.user_id WHERE AND d.attempts < 3 AND d.next_attempt_at <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND (d.status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') OR (d.status='SENDING' AND d.lease_until <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})) ORDER BY d.next_attempt_at,d.notification_id,p.subscription_id FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE community_push_deliveries SET status=CASE WHEN #{status}='RETRY' AND attempts>=3 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE #{status} END, next_attempt_at=#{retryAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},lease_until=NULL,claim_token=NULL, delivered_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='SENT' THEN #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ELSE delivered_at END WHERE notification_id=#{notificationId} AND subscription_id=#{subscriptionId} AND status='SENDING' AND claim_token=#{claimToken}
